libmedia AVPlayer 1.3.1
Copyright (C) 2024-present, Gaoxing Zhao

This package contains unmodified official @libmedia/avplayer 1.3.1 UMD
files and selected official E-AC-3, HEVC, audio-resampling and time-stretch
WebAssembly modules. The original package.json and README.md are retained.
Web1's adapter is separate from these replaceable library files.

Official project and pinned source:
https://github.com/zhaohappy/libmedia/tree/152f629d3021fd8013efa464fcb7b55f9fbe7753
https://github.com/zhaohappy/libmedia/archive/152f629d3021fd8013efa464fcb7b55f9fbe7753.tar.gz
Official prebuilt JavaScript package:
https://registry.npmjs.org/@libmedia/avplayer/-/avplayer-1.3.1.tgz

The JavaScript package declares LGPL-3.0-or-later. COPYING.LGPLv3 and the
incorporated GPLv3 text are included. Upstream identifies FFmpeg as the
source of codec/resampling modules and SoundTouch as the source of time
stretching. COPYING.LGPLv2.1 is also included for those upstream components.
See the pinned source README and build scripts for component details.

FFmpeg upstream: https://ffmpeg.org/
SoundTouch upstream: https://www.surina.net/soundtouch/
Pinned libmedia build scripts:
https://github.com/zhaohappy/libmedia/tree/152f629d3021fd8013efa464fcb7b55f9fbe7753/build
Pinned embedded SoundTouch sources:
https://github.com/zhaohappy/libmedia/tree/152f629d3021fd8013efa464fcb7b55f9fbe7753/packages/audiostretchpitch/src/clib/soundtouch

No x264/x265 encoding modules or other encoders are included. The Web1
adapter directly decodes media and does not create converted media copies.
You may replace the library files with a compatible modified build; the adapter is provided in editable source form. See the source and license terms
for modification and redistribution rights.

Corresponding source materials for this distribution:
https://github.com/OuNiSang/DanDanPlay-Personal-Web-Style/releases/download/3.5/DanDanPlay-Personal-Web-Style-3.5-corresponding-source.zip
FFmpeg source: https://github.com/zhaohappy/FFmpeg/tree/a216f26d6ed993bdc12d842cdab3f91bd0b31909
The upstream generated ffversion.h at the decoder rebuild commit and at
the pinned libmedia revision both declare n7.0.1-8-ga216f26d6e. This is the
upstream same-version source declaration; no bit-reproducible build was
performed. The decoder build script enables GPL and version3. These WASM
components are not represented as LGPL-only. Full source, build scripts,
license documents, pinned submodules and the evidence are supplied in the
separate source attachment. See its README for the source layout.
To use a modified decoder build, replace the library/WASM files and update
the adapter's explicit byte-length expectations if those files change size.
There is no cryptographic or account restriction on modified versions.
